NativeBoundary.NullGalaxy: C# throws ArgumentNullException; native typed spans cannot represent null.
NativeBoundary.NullSystemRecord: C# reference lists can contain null; native StellarSystem spans cannot.
NativeBoundary.NullBodyRecord: C# reference lists can contain null; native PlanetaryBody spans cannot.
NativeBoundary.NullEnvironment: C# PlanetaryBodyState can be constructed with a null environment; native embeds it by value.
